messages:
alana: Uploaded updated Figma frames for the first-run setup checklist + sample app cards. Need quick feedback on copy, compact vs persistent patterns, and any a11y red flags before I freeze.
sofia: Reviewing now. main tradeoff: persistent quickstart rail (docks on the right) vs single modal flow. rail keeps users in context, modal forces completion.
mike: lean toward rail too. Mobile concern: vertical height. Proposal: make rail collapsible and auto-hide after session end.
rahul: collapsible rail = CSS + small JS. localStorage ok for self-serve but enterprise/private should be able to restore via backend.
jess: agree we need server-side restore for demo orgs to avoid support tickets when progress disappears.
sofia: microcopy idea: checklist step titles should be verb-first. e.g. "Add model" -> "Connect a model or try the sandbox" to set expectation.
aria: accessibility checklist:
- controls must be reachable by keyboard; ensure `aria-expanded` on rail toggle
- CTA contrast must meet 4.5:1 for small text
- ephemeral token disclosure should be read by screen readers and marked `aria-live` if shown once
mike: UI copy tweak: CTA on sample cards -> "Open sample app" (short), and show a subline "Runs in sandbox" when applicable.
jess: demo auth flow: create a short-lived org + single-use token shown once with copy `This token will not be shown again`. TTL 24h.
rahul: technical: avoid showing raw key in DOM for long; render in a modal and revoke after copy or on timeout.
sofia: on sample templates: let's start with 3 focused flows (chat assistant, semantic search, summarizer) and add a "Browse gallery" for more.
mike: include tiny metrics on cards: "est tokens / expected latency" and a small badge: `sandbox` / `dedicated` where relevant.
alana: action items:
- mike: update Figma with collapsible rail + card variants (due Tue)
- sofia + aria: finalize microcopy + a11y checklist (due Mon)
- rahul + jess: design demo org + ephemeral token UX (due Thu)
- me: draft analytics events for first-run funnel and empty-state copy (due Wed)
jess: analytics events: `onboard.start`, `sample.launch`, `token.copied`, `onboard.complete` — will add to tracking doc.
aria: I'll run a VoiceOver/JAWS pass once Figma updates are in and flag any focus issues.
rahul: I'll prototype client store + feature-flag for server restore, will share PR link when ready.
sofia: UX detail: after checklist completion show a compact "Completed" chip with subtle confetti and a "Replay walkthrough" option in settings.
mike: question: dismissible checklist or keep visible in a completed state? UX prefers visible but minimized.
alana: prefer minimized but visible. also swap jargon: replace "KV-cache warmup" with "speed tweaks" in user copy.
sofia: A/B test idea: "Open sample app" vs "Launch sample" on a small cohort of new accounts.
jess: can run the A/B in hosted quickstart only.
alana: thanks y'all, I'll post Figma link + task board in ~45m :smile: 
ops-bot: Preview build available at https://staging.redwood.ai/onboard/preview (build 2026-03-22_18:03)
